title: The LemonSlice Cartoon Model
summary: The LemonSlice Cartoon Model brings cartoon characters to life with maximum animation: highly expressive real-time avatars from a single image, from 3D mascots to anime. Available today on all plans.
body_markdown:
Today we're launching the LemonSlice Cartoon Model: a new real-time avatar model built to bring cartoon characters to life with maximum animation.


Cartoon characters play by different rules than photorealistic avatars, and audiences expect to see that when talking to them. The Cartoon Model is trained for exactly that.


- **Maximum animation.** Exaggerated expressions, with lively head and body movement. Lip sync works even with non-standard mouth shapes.
- **Any style.** 3D mascots, anime, storybook illustrations, animals, creatures, even talking objects. If it has a face, it works.
- **One image.** Avatars are created from a single reference image, making it super easy to get started.


## Interactive Examples


Captain Pip, which way should we go?


Professor Shelly, how do sea turtles find their way home?


Hey, Mochi, what's on my schedule today?


Gizmo, what do you miss most about home?


How do I say good morning in Japanese?


Any tips for this boss fight?


What's beyond the forest?


How should I warm up before a run?


## How to use it


In the LemonSlice[playground](https://lemonslice.com/avatars) , choose the Cartoon model in your avatar's settings page. In the API, set` model` to` "cartoon"` when you start a session. Refer to the our[documentation](https://lemonslice.com/docs/reference/cartoon-model) for full details.


The Cartoon model is available today on all subscription plans. We can't wait to see what you build!
